d: S2:E13 The Kuryllowicz Family - In the Kuryllowicz household, Mom and Dad's home-based business has literally taken over… And it's pushing the family to the brink. Their basement has become an upside-down workshop, the living room is an impassable office space, there are filing cabinets in the cluttered bedrooms…

S1:E5 Sunday Lunches - For many of us Sunday lunches are one of our favourite pub food experiences. Sundays are a time to relax over cooking and enjoy a hearty lunch with family and friends and Tom wants to show us how to make our usual Sunday roasts a bit more special.

S1:E6 Family Food - In this episode, Tom wants to show us his version of some real family favourites. These dishes are inspired by the food he enjoyed growing up, made with simple ingredients that the family will love.

S2:E1 Crowd Pleasers - In this episode, Tom's serving up some great crowd pleasing dishes, perfect for sharing with mates at a party. However, there are no canapes on this menu – Tom likes to make proper hearty food for his guests that you can eat in your hands, packed full of flavour.

S2:E2 Takeaway - In this episode, Tom creates dishes inspired by some of his favourite takeaway foods.  This is the kind of casual grab and go food that puts a smile on people's faces. He starts with a puff pastry pizza that saves on making pizza dough and is topped with delicious crispy beef.

st: S2:E10 My Big Fat Wedding Dress
d: S2:E10 My Big Fat Wedding Dress - Bride-to-be Pam is an emotional wreck and her soon-to-be husband Matt is trying to keep his cool… But with the big event only twelve days away, they're both starting to feel the heat.

S2:E11 Going To The Dogs - Alisa and Kevin's wedding is falling apart… And to make matters worse, the bride is stuck doing damage control while her man is out shopping for new clothes! But with only two weeks to go, they're both feeling the pressure...

S2:E12 West Side Wedding - Simone and Roger are ready to tie the knot… but fear their clashing cultures may turn the wedding into a disaster! So along with juggling a newborn and planning their big event, the couple is desperately trying to keep their families happy.

S1:E13 The Barrys - David and Mary are desperate to move closer to their grandchildren, but after 18 months on the market and a staggering £90,000 price cut, their East Boldon family home of 30 years has only been viewed once.

S1:E14 The Kinchleas - With a three-hour commute to Dad's new job (and to the family's temporary crash pad in the neighbourhood), the Kinchleas are desperate to sell their three-bedroom, Victorian mid-terrace home in Bow, East London…

S1:E15 The Lotts - Tired of his long daily commute, Gary wants to sell his riverside property next to London's Limehouse Basin and move closer to work… But after six months, only four viewings, and not a single offer, his home is languishing on the market.

S1:E16 The Williams - Dennis and Sue are desperate to sell their two-bedroom Thamesmead home so they can permanently reunite in the country… But, after a year on the market, few viewings, four agents, and two major price cuts, Sue's already moved to Norfolk while Dennis is stuck in their unsellable home.
S1:E3 Carri-Ann | Eileen - A former beauty queen can't quite commit to the wedding dress and a Kim Kardashian look alike bride finds a dress fit for an Armenian princess.
